title: Seven proven keys to quickly close care gaps by upcoming HEDIS and CMS Stars deadlines
summary: Electronic health records integrations with genetic testing increases operational efficiency, enhances the provider experience and offers precision medicine at scale.
body_markdown:
Closing care gaps in preventive screenings, chronic care management, and other high-impact HEDIS measures is critical for health plans and providers to achieve optimal quality ratings and incentive payments. Whether you're managing a Medicare Advantage (MA) plan, a Medicaid Managed Care Organization (MCO), a commercial population health program or an Accountable Care Organization (ACO), it can be especially stressful as the pressure to close gaps in care intensifies when HEDIS and CMS Stars deadlines approach.


**When deadlines loom, healthcare organizations often grapple with several challenges, including:**


1. Fragmented data
2. Persistent care gaps
3. Incomplete open orders
4. Identifying fast, scalable interventions
5. Inconsistent member engagement
6. Provider capacity, fatigue, or reluctance to act
7. Prioritizing outreach, at scale, for those who need it most


The expanding role of gap closure adds to these challenges. It now sits at the center of value-based care performance, influencing quality outcomes, risk stratification, health equity, and total cost of care.


As a result, leading organizations are changing how they respond. Rather than focusing narrowly on closing gaps at year end, plans are building continuous, data-driven strategies connecting clinical insight to action throughout the year.
